content:
Ava (Growth): Quick plan check for next week's webinar promo (codename: Spark). Short arc: X tease -> X reminder -> LinkedIn carousel. Seed DMs to warm accounts only. KPI: 200 signups, 25 enterprise leads. :sparkles:

Ben (Content): I'll draft 2 X thread openers + 4-slide LinkedIn carousel. Need hero (1200x628) + small latency gif (4s). Can turn copy around if assets in drive by 4pm. :art:

Claire (Demand): Pulling warm list now (~850 contacts). Will tag leads with "spark_webinar" and create seeded shortlinks per variant. Suggest A/B headline: "Predictable inference latency" vs "Cut inference spend without quality loss".

Dan (Ops): Proposed schedule (PDT): X tease Wed 09:30, X reminder Thu 10:00, LinkedIn Thu 10:10. Seed DMs 45m after each post to top 40 accounts. I'll prepare CSV for Buffer import.

Ava (Growth): DMs only for engagement score > 70 + enterprise flag. Registration form = email only. UTMs: utm_campaign=spark&utm_source={channel}&utm_medium=social&utm_content={variant}.

Ben (Content): Draft lines:
- "See how we balance latency, cost, and quality in production inference. Live demo + numbers."
- "Practical configs that lowered unit cost with no quality drop. Join us."

Claire (Demand): Shortlinks created: https://rwd.ai/sparkA and https://rwd.ai/sparkB. I'll queue a warm-email 10m after first X post. SDRs - can you handle outreach if we get 250 signups? @SDR Team

SDR Team: We can manage ~180 immediate follow-ups. If >180, prioritize enterprise and highest intent. Auto-assign senior reps for enterprise accounts. :white_check_mark:

Dan (Ops): Scheduler CSV sample: "platform,iso_time,variant,asset,link,utm"
"X,2026-06-02T16:30:00Z,teaseA,hero_spark_v1.png,https://rwd.ai/sparkA,utm_campaign=spark&utm_content=teaseA"

Ben (Content): Upload folder: https://drive.redwood/marketing/spark-drafts. I'll add alt text and notes.

Ava (Growth): EOD checklist: Ben upload assets, Claire seed links + email queue, Dan import schedule + DM flow, SDR Team share prioritization doc. Quick pre-launch standup tomorrow 09:00 PT.

MarketingBot: Drafts saved to scheduler. Approval reminder set for 17:00 PT.
